name: fmp_analyst_estimates
description:
Analyst consensus estimates for one company from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/analyst-estimates): estimated revenue, EPS, EBITDA, net income and SG&A (low/high/average) for coming periods.
Returns {symbol, period, estimates}: estimates is the list of FMP period records.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, e.g. AAPL; upper-cased), period (annual or quarter; default annual), limit (integer 1-100, number of periods; default 5).
For reported figures use fmp_income_statement; for price targets fmp_price_target or fmp_price_target_summary; for rating changes fmp_upgrades_downgrades.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {"symbol": "NVDA", "period": "annual", "limit": 3}

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL)
